report.title: RBI Cyber Security Framework - Database Activity Report
report.author: DBDOME Security Team (dbexpert.ai)

sections.text: RBI Cyber Security Framework - Database Activity Monitoring Report

sections.content: Compliance evidence aligned to the RBI Cyber Security Framework for regulated entities, generated automatically by the DBDOME platform. Focus areas: privileged-access monitoring, detection of unauthorized/anomalous access, security incident logging and reporting, database security posture, and tamper-proof audit trails.

sections.query: SELECT CASE WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC01' THEN 'Unknown Login' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC02' THEN 'Unexpected Program' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC03' THEN 'Unexpected Database' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC04' THEN 'Suspicious Patterns' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC05' THEN 'PII Access' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC06' THEN 'SQL Injection' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC07' THEN 'After Hours' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC08' THEN 'Privilege Escalation' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC09' THEN 'Data Exfiltration' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC10' THEN 'Multi-Host Login' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC11' THEN 'Schema Recon' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC12' THEN 'Dormant Account' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC13' THEN 'Mass Modification' ELSE metric_name END AS anomaly_type, COUNT(*) AS findings FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results WHERE metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010%%' AND metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY anomaly_type ORDER BY findings DESC
sections.title: Anomalous Database Activity by Type (7 days)
sections.caption: Distribution of confirmed anomalous-activity findings over the last 7 days

sections.query: SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_name AS root_cause_id, (gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count')::int AS events, COALESCE(gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity','high') AS severity, gm.entry_date AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE (gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC08%%' OR gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-AUD-026%%') AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_incidents, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state NOT IN ('CLOSED','RESOLVED')) AS open_incidents, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity IN ('HIGH','CRITICAL','high','critical')) AS high_severity FROM log.incidents WHERE detected_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
sections.template: Last 30 days: {total_incidents} security incidents logged, {open_incidents} currently open, {high_severity} high/critical.

sections.query: SELECT incident_id, title, severity, category, state, server_name, detected_at, resolved_at FROM log.incidents WHERE detected_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_name AS root_cause_id, COALESCE(rc.name, gm.metric_name) AS control, COALESCE(gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity','medium') AS severity, gm.entry_date AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm LEFT JOIN rootcause.root_causes rc ON rc.root_cause_id = gm.metric_name WHERE (gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-CFG%%' OR gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ENC%%' OR gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-NET%%') AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT event_time, server_name, db_user, client_ip, matched_policy, action_taken, risk_score FROM log.firewall_audit_log WHERE event_time >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT table_name, rows_hashed, last_hashed_id, verified_at, CASE WHEN is_valid THEN 'INTACT' ELSE 'BROKEN' END AS chain_status, broken_at_id FROM log.hash_chain_checkpoints ORDER BY verified_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20
